# project conventions (CLAUDE.md):
# Apparently — Tech Stack & Development Guide

**Tech Stack:** Nuxt 4 (Vue 3) + TypeScript + Supabase (PostgreSQL + RLS) + Vercel + Anthropic Claude API + Tailwind CSS

## Directory Map
- `app/` — Vue 3 frontend (pages, components, stores, layouts, composables)
- `server/` — Nitro backend (handlers under `api/`, reusable logic in `engines/` and `utils/`)
- `server/engines/` — Pure domain logic (licensing, rewards, legal-opinions, regulator-intel, disclosure, self-improvement, coordination, email-triage)
- `server/api/` — HTTP handler routes, mirrors `server/` structure with `.ts` or `.get.ts`/`.post.ts` suffixes
- `shared/` — Shared TypeScript types and schemas (validation with Zod)
- `supabase/` — Migrations (numbered `NNN_name.sql`), RLS policies, seed data
- `tests/` — Vitest unit/integration tests (mirrored folder structure, `*.test.ts` suffix)
- `scripts/` — Node.js CLI tools for setup, backfills, audits (not committed to build)
- `public/` — Static assets, HTML dashboards with `%%SUPABASE_URL%%` / `%%SUPABASE_KEY%%` placeholders
- `types/` — Generated Supabase types + custom TypeScript definitions
- `eval/`, `corpus/`, `docs/` — Research, knowledge base, documentation (not source code)

## Commands
```bash
npm run dev                    # Start dev (localhost:3000)
npm run build                  # Build for production
npm test                       # Run Vitest (unit/integration)
npm run test:watch             # Vitest watch mode
npm run test:e2e               # Playwright end-to-end tests
npm run typecheck              # TypeScript via Nuxt (strict)
npm run lint                   # ESLint (server/ and app/)
npm run check:schema-contract  # Verify DB column contracts
npm run check:schema-columns   # Verify schema columns (--fail-on-missing)
npm run check:ai-calls         # Verify AI calls are logged
npm run check:rls              # Audit RLS policies
npm run check:nocheck-ratchet  # Enforce @ts-nocheck removal ratchet
npm run check:dead-code        # Dead code detection (knip)
npm run smoke                  # Smoke tests
npm run a11y:check             # Accessibility audit (axe)
npm run gen:types              # Regenerate Supabase types
npm run migrations:audit       # Audit migration history
npm run migrations:apply       # Apply pending migrations
npm run eval                   # Run eval suite
```

## Naming & Style Conventions
- **TypeScript everywhere** — strict mode enforced by `nuxi typecheck`
- **camelCase** for variables/functions; `PascalCa
